name: Mainstream Medical Devices
old_description: From initial concept to production, we reduce costs, maximize profitability, and shorten lead times all while delivering top-notch customer service.
about:
Based in Austin, Texas, Mainstream Medical Devices operates as a contract manufacturer and packager specializing in single-use medical devices. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed; however, CEO Dana Wilcox joined in April 2019, bringing over 25 years of industry experience and identifying a need for a right-sized supplier in sterile packaging to complement the firm's focus on disposable instruments.

The company provides contract manufacturing, contract packaging, and its proprietary Build-a-Kit™ assembly service for single-use medical instruments. Its offerings span sterile packaging solutions, manufacturing solutions, and OEM product development, serving medical device companies from concept through commercialization. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Mainstream serves the medical device industry, targeting original equipment manufacturers and developers of single-use, disposable instruments and sterile packaging. The leadership team includes President Aaron Bailey, with 30-plus years in medical device commercialization; Senior Director of Operations Casey Atkins, an ASQ-certified quality auditor with experience at Smith+Nephew and Integra LifeSciences; and Director of Quality Ken Thoma, whose background covers orthopedics, active implantables, and in-vitro diagnostics.

The firm emphasizes integrity across its people, products, and partners, aiming to raise industry safety and quality standards through innovative packaging and manufacturing solutions. Wilcox has stated the company was positioned to fill a gap for a right-sized supplier that offers personal attention larger providers cannot, while maintaining a proven track record in developing and commercializing medical devices.
